source.note: Frozen closure-package card. Sigma_f explicitly certifies that NOTHING in the SM lens expresses WHY there are three generations or the mass/mixing hierarchy -- these are MEASURED INPUTS, non-definable predicates.

target.note: Registered open_question node (rubric A.7): 'why three fermion generations + their mass/mixing hierarchy'. node_kind forces the E0/E3 branch ONLY; can NEVER seal E1/E2 (no accepted_observables to descend into, no named principle imported into it). Inherits no fresh casting.

precondition_step0.not_no_faithful_M: A faithful finite flavor-space toy model WAS built (descent-test is built-and-failed, NOT vacuous); this is distinct from the QM<->GR no_faithful_M route.

toy_model_M.carrier: Finite flavor space of dimension Ng=3 (three generations as a replication index).
toy_model_M.L0_native_target_probe: Generation-SYMMETRIC (generation-blind) functional(s): the open-question layer's own Sigma_f has NO predicate that distinguishes a generation or sets a scale; modeled as the all-ones probe (and a symmetric quadratic at finer resolution). This is what an 'explanation' layer can see PRIOR to importing the measured inputs.
toy_model_M.D0_dissolving_source_probe: SM generation-RESOLVED readout: hierarchical Yukawa-like diagonal entries yuk ~ (1e-5, 7e-3, 1.0) isolating each generation's mass scale; finer stage adds CKM-like off-diagonal mixing observables. This is the structure the target is asked to explain.
toy_model_M.readout_map_to_accepted_observables: D0 rows map to SM accepted_observables (generation masses, CKM mixings); L0 maps to the (empty) generation-distinguishing predicate set of the open_question node.

descent.robustness: Tested: Xi=0 is reachable ONLY by handing the target a full generation-RESOLVING identity probe (Case C, Xi=0) -- i.e. by importing the measured Yukawas / generation count the question is asking to EXPLAIN. That is the forbidden over-read (gate E.3) and the reductionist relapse (gate E.0) the SM card explicitly warns against. With any HONEST generation-symmetric target vocabulary Xi stays stably ~0.67. Non-factorization (B.2) holds: ker L0 is NOT contained in ker D0.
descent.result: NO finite descent. Xi > 0 stably. Not E1. (Independently barred from E1 because the open_question target cannot seal E1.)

recognition.searched: Anomaly cancellation (constrains per-generation CONTENT, not the generation COUNT -- holds for any N); Z-invisible-width N_nu=3 (an EMPIRICAL input/measurement, not a closure principle that derives the count); GUT / family-symmetry / Froggatt-Nielsen / discrete-flavor-symmetry models and string-landscape arguments (all not_established and speculative -- adopting them is the GUT-casting smuggle the SM card explicitly REJECTS as wrongly flattering).
recognition.result: No named, load-bearing, accepted external principle DERIVES the generation count or the mass/mixing hierarchy under a stated assumption. Recognition-search returns nothing named. Not E2. (Independently barred: open_question target cannot seal E2.)

emergence_run.reason: Unlike QCD->hadron-masses (E001), where lattice QCD is a constructible run METHOD that generates the spectrum from a FIXED substrate, there is NO existing substrate-run method whose execution yields '3 generations' or the Yukawa hierarchy as a non-descending readout. In the SM the generation count and the Yukawas are INPUTS put in by hand, not readouts of any run. No deeper fixed substrate + run produces them. E0 requires a POSITIVELY constructed run-object and a pre-frozen run_target_stub (gates E.7 / O4); none exists.
emergence_run.result: No constructible run-only non-descending object. Not E0. (E0 is not a doubt-haven, gate E.5.)

gap.located_missing_predicate: The SM lens Sigma_f contains NO predicate that distinguishes the generation count or fixes the Yukawa hierarchy; the generation-resolving information enters as an INPUT, not as a consequence. Factorization D0 = A L0 fails because the generation-symmetric source vocabulary cannot resolve the per-generation hierarchical scales.
gap.where_factorization_fails: ker L0 (generation-symmetric) is not contained in ker D0 (generation-resolved); the Schur-complement blind-spot currency Xi ~ 0.67 (~67-69% of source currency unexplained) is the located obstruction.
gap.sharpened_restatement: Why exactly three fermion generations, and what fixes their hierarchical mass/mixing pattern, is a typed OPEN GAP: no finite coarse-graining of the SM source layer produces it, no named external principle imports it under a stated assumption, and no constructible run generates it from a fixed deeper substrate.

modality_tier_compat_B8: emergence-up x E3 is an emittable pair (B.8 table: emergence-up may be E2/E0/E3, never E1).

anti_control.e7_e0_interlock_booleans: N/A -- not sealed E0; no run-target stub claimed. (Bare E0 would have been demoted to E3 anyway per gate E.7/O4.)
anti_control.note: Blind first-principles application of the decision-procedure independently lands E3. SBT does NOT secretly derive the generation count / mass hierarchy.

rationale: Source resolves to a frozen SM card whose Sigma_f explicitly marks the generation count and mass/mixing hierarchy as non-definable MEASURED INPUTS. Target is an open_question node that forces the E0/E3 branch. STEP 1 descent-test on a declared finite flavor-space toy model gives Xi ~ 0.67-0.72 (Frobenius) at two refinements -- stably > 0, no flip (gate E.9) -- so non-factorization holds and there is no clean E1 descent; a robustness check shows Xi=0 only by smuggling the generation-resolved inputs (forbidden over-read, gates E.0/E.3). STEP 2 recognition-search finds NO named external principle that derives the count or hierarchy (anomaly cancellation fixes content not count; GUT/flavor/landscape models are not_established and explicitly rejected by the card). STEP 3 run-search finds NO constructible run-object: the generations/Yukawas are inputs, not readouts of any fixed-substrate run (contrast E001 lattice QCD). STEP 4 forecloses: SEAL E3, sharpened gap, with the missing predicate located in Sigma_f.
